d1.line_text: Auto-scroll to business hours. On initial day-view load and when navigating to a new day, the timeline auto-scrolls so the working-day start sits at the left edge of the visible area (with a small 30 to 60 minute buffer before it). The start time comes from the same hierarchy shifts use: the earliest technician's configured start if tech hours are set, otherwise business hours, otherwise 7:00 AM.
